1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 16.03.1996 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (Economics Offence), Jhansi in Case No. 775/93/94 convicting and sentencing revisionist under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (Economics Offence), Jhansi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereagainst accused-revisionist preferred appeal which has been dismissed by 8th Additional Sessions Judge, Jhansi vide judgment and order dated 20.09.1996.
This revision has been filed challenging both the aforesaid orders.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
Joginder Lal vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2019

entities.text: Joginder Lal vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The revisionist Joginder Lal is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jhansi shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be reported within two months.
6. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
